name: ATB_AUTH_SERVICE_DETAILS
description: This table contains information about the service being requested for authorization.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the Auth Bundle record.

columns.name: AUTH_SVC_CODE_REP_C_NAME
columns.description: The Service Code Representation category ID for the Auth Bundle.This item outlines what the "code" is that this Service represents. A code could be a recognized code set, a list or range of those code set values, or a free text string.

columns.name: AUTH_REV_CODE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the Revenue Code that details the care that this particular service outlines.

columns.name: AUTH_REV_CODE_ID_REVENUE_CODE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the revenue code.

columns.name: AUTH_MEDICATION_ID_MEDICATION_NAME
columns.description: The name of this medication record.

columns.name: AUTH_PA_AMT_QUANTITY_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Quantity Type category ID for the Auth Bundle's count information.

columns.name: AUTH_QUANTITY
columns.description: The Quantity amount for the Auth Bundle's count information.

columns.name: AUTH_PA_AMT_FREQUENCY_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Frequency Type category ID for the Auth Bundle's count information.

columns.name: AUTH_FREQUENCY
columns.description: The Frequency amount for the Auth Bundle's count information.

columns.name: AUTH_PA_AMT_PERIOD_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Period Type category ID for the Auth Bundle's count information.

columns.name: AUTH_PERIODS
columns.description: The Periods amount for the Auth Bundle's count information.

columns.name: AUTH_BED_DAY_TYPE_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the Bed Day for Auth Bundle services that pertain to Bed Days.

columns.name: AUTH_BED_DAY_TYPE_ID_BED_DAY_TYPE_NAME
columns.description: The name of the bed day type record (i.e. ICU or non-authorized.)

columns.name: AUTH_BED_DAY_COUNT
columns.description: The count of days that this service represents, if this service pertains to Bed Days.

columns.name: AUTH_NIGHT_COUNT
columns.description: The count of nights that this service represents, if this service pertains to Bed Days.
